scripts.package: node build.mjs --store && cd chrome-extension && zip -qr ../html2figma-extension.zip . && cd .. && echo 'Chrome Web Store 업로드용 → packages/extension/html2figma-extension.zip'
scripts.package:internal: node build.mjs --internal && node test/no-billing-in-internal.mjs && cd chrome-extension-internal && zip -qr ../html2figma-extension-internal.zip . && cd .. && echo '사내 배포용 (무료 무제한) → packages/extension/html2figma-extension-internal.zip'
scripts.test: esbuild test/pipeline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-test/pipeline.mjs && node dist-test/pipeline.mjs && esbuild test/quota.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist-test/quota.mjs && node dist-test/quota.mjs
scripts.test:builds: node build.mjs --store && node build.mjs --internal && node test/no-billing-in-internal.mjs
scripts.clean: rm -rf chrome-extension chrome-extension-internal dist-test html2figma-extension.zip html2figma-extension-internal.zip
